[P2] Return to design before changing the public API

Rule 3 requires a design note for this new public error hierarchy and namespace migration. The description explains the selected implementation but neither compares alternatives, including simplification under rule 2, nor links a maintainer-agreed design note. That leaves the hierarchy and compatibility policy without the required design review. Return to the design phase under rule 8, step 6, and obtain agreement on the options and chosen approach.
